MPESB Subedar Steno, ASI Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Subedar (Stenographer) & Assistant Sub-Inspector. This recruitment has been issued for 655 posts. The online application process for MPESB MP Police Subedar Steno, ASI Recruitment 2026 will start from 09 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 23 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB MP Police Subedar Steno, ASI Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 September 2026
  • Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 October 2026
  • Last Date Correction : 13 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 03 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD : Rs. 310/-
  • Portal Charges Extra Include
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
